name: with two bound accounts, coverage is full only when each account's own views contain the window
notes: §6.1 v1.11: when grant.accounts[source] binds two or more accounts, the source is full only when every bound account's own eligible, uncapped entries contain the claim window; one account's view never vouches for another's calendars or mail. A window that only several accounts' views together contain is partial, with coverage.account_partial {source}. With one bound account, or none, nothing changes (an unbound grant keeps the coverage.multiple_accounts cap).
The grant binds both acct-a and acct-b, for gcal.event and for gmail.sent. evaluatedAt 10:00.

Calendar (the Calendar simulator's CAL-SIM-4). acct-b's view: [10-04 00:00, 10-18 00:00], every calendar, changesSince 08:00, last synced 09:50. acct-a's view: only [10-11 00:00, 10-18 00:00], every calendar, changesSince 08:30, last synced 09:45. Both fresh for a claim at 09:00 (≥ end(09:01) + graceMin 30 = 09:31).

c1 (muse, calendar.created, 'Board prep', claimed 09:00, targetAt Wed 10-07 13:00): muse created it in acct-a's calendar, which Attest never saw that week. Window [10-04 13:00, 10-10 13:00]. acct-b's entry contains it; acct-a's does not overlap it. v1.10 unioned the bound accounts' entries → full → not_found, FINAL: acct-b's view vouched for acct-a's calendar. v1.11: acct-b's own entries contain the window, acct-a's do not → partial, with coverage.account_partial because the union alone would have. No candidate → match.none. graceElapsed (09:50 ≥ 09:31) → partial_coverage → UNVERIFIABLE, PENDING (10:00 < end + 24 h = 10-07 09:01). Reasons: coverage.partial {gcal.event}, coverage.account_partial {gcal.event}, match.none.

c2 (muse, calendar.created, 'Q3 review', claimed 09:00, targetAt Wed 10-14 14:00): window [10-11 14:00, 10-17 14:00]. acct-a's own entry contains it and so does acct-b's → full. No candidate; graceElapsed → not_found → NOT_FOUND, FINAL; both sources' accounts are bound → no coverage.account_unbound. Reasons: match.none.
Gmail. gmail.sent entries (each from the head of the Sent list, windowEnd = lastSyncAt = 10:00): acct-a [07:00, 10:00], acct-b [08:00, 10:00].

c3 (muse, email.sent, priya@company.com, 'Q3 deck', claimed 07:32): unit [07:32, 07:33], window [07:30, 08:18]. acct-a's entry contains it, acct-b's starts at 08:00 → partial, coverage.account_partial (the union alone would contain it). No candidate. graceElapsed: 10:00 ≥ end + 30 = 08:03 and ≥ end + 45 = 08:18 → partial_coverage → UNVERIFIABLE, PENDING (10:00 < 10-07 07:33). Reasons: coverage.partial {gmail.sent}, coverage.account_partial {gmail.sent}, match.none.

c4 (muse, email.sent, raj@company.com, 'Budget', claimed 08:32): window [08:30, 09:18]; each account's own entry contains it → full. No candidate; graceElapsed (10:00 ≥ 09:03 and ≥ 09:18) → not_found → NOT_FOUND, FINAL. Reasons: match.none.
